blocks.text: Leviticus 24 contains 23 verses. It opens with: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying, It concludes with: And Moses spake to the children of Israel; and they brought forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. And the children of Israel did as Jehovah commanded Moses. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: Leviticus moves from sacrifice and priestly inauguration through purity and the Day of Atonement into instructions for holy communal life, sacred time, land, covenant consequences, and vows.
